1662-2645-3430-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
1662-2645-3430-7014.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Karoo
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

728-2464-3249-5004.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-5004.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-5004.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

553-1470-2928.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Tidal Barracuda.
In response, cast Hinder by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

643-2292-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-2292-4302.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4968-6919-7267.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Michelangelo.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4968-6919-7267.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

997-1734-2150.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-2919-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-2919-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

112-799-6496.manaNeeded: {10}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-799-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-799-6496.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one legendary creature and/or planeswalker.
112-799-6496.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and exiling the original Karn's Temporal Sundering with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Karn's Temporal Sundering copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Karn's Temporal Sundering and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn's Temporal Sundering's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Karn's Temporal Sundering and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Karn's Temporal Sundering's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-799-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Karn's Temporal Sundering is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Karn's Temporal Sundering is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

2653-2893-5478-6168.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

586-1069-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
586-1069-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Gix.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Gix.
The Equipment's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

567-3490-4659-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-3490-4659-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2919-3490-4659-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4659-6097.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3179-4050-6073-6992.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of creatures equal to or greater than 7 plus Leonardo's commander tax, if applicable.
3179-4050-6073-6992.description:
Cast Leonardo either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} due to its cost reduction.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
When Leonardo enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonardo, adding {W}.
Put Leonardo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3200-4359.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2478-6965.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1429-4050-6792.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1350-5733-6333-6678.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1350-5733-6333-6678.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1350-5733-6333-6678.description:
Cast Notorious Throng from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Notorious Throng, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

772-997-6553.easyPrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
772-997-6553.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

341-1690-2538-5034.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Umori.
341-1690-2538-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
341-1690-2538-5034.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

224-2248-2841.description:
During any opponent's turn, activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Activate Ghost Town's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1524-5256-6481.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ilharg.
When Ilharg dies, it triggers, putting itself into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Ilharg's power, ultimately milling Ilharg.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting Ilharg from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

826-1636-5256-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-5256-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

719-1429-2511-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-2511-5402.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1652-1741-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
1652-1741-5626.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Cloud of Faeries from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Cloud of Faeries and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1636-4319-4424-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
1636-4319-4424-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature When the creature dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.

3398-3920-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Valduk has at least seven Auras and/or Equipments attached to it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
3398-3920-4050.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Valduk triggers, creating at least seven 3/1 Elemental creature tokens with trample and haste.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Elementals, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Valduk has at least eight Auras and/or Equipments attached to it, this combo nets infinite Elemental tokens and colored mana.

957-2493-4050-4935.manaNeeded: {8}{U} each odd-numbered turn, with {2}{U}{U} available each even-numbered turn
957-2493-4050-4935.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Conduit of Worlds by tapping it, causing you to pay {2}{U}{U} to cast Archaeomancer from your graveyard.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

1283-2034-2579-2986-3139.description:
Cast Growth-Chamber Guardian by paying {1}{G}.
Growth-Chamber Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering The Great Henge, putting a +1/+1 counter on Growth-Chamber Guardian and drawing you a card.
Growth-Chamber Guardian triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Growth-Chamber Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
Growth-Chamber Guardian dies, triggering The Caludron of Eternity, putting Growth-Chamber Guardian on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Growth-Chamber Guardian trigger from step 3, searching your library for Growth-Chamber Guardian and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.

224-654-4165-4967.notablePrerequisites:
Wind Zendikon attached to Thawing Glaciers.
Thawing Glaciers does not have summoning sickness.
224-654-4165-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

313-325-1742-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five cards in hand.
313-325-1742-4050.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Toluz triggers, exiling the discarded card.
Repeat from step 1 until you have an empty hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toluz, adding one mana of any color.
Toluz dies, returning all cards exiled with it to your hand.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Toluz from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Toluz enters the battlefield, causing it to connive.
Repeat.

11-2802-3584.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant or sorcery spell this turn.
11-2802-3584.description:
Cast Invoke Calamity by paying {1}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Invoke Calamity a number of times equal to the number of other instants and sorceries you have cast this turn.
Resolve all but two of the copies of Invoke Calamity and the original Invoke Calamity, choosing not to cast any instant or sorcery spells as they resolve.
Resolve a copy of Invoke Calamity, casting Narset's Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Narset's Reversal a number of times equal to the number of other instants and sorceries you have cast this turn, targeting the original Narset's Reversal with the first copy of Narset's Reversal and targeting the original Invoke Calamity with all other copies of Narset's Reversal.
Resolve a copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Invoke Calamity and returning it to your hand.
Resolve the newly copied Invoke Calamity, choosing not to cast any instant or sorcery spells as it resolves.
Each remaining copy of Narset's Reversal that was targeting the original Invoke Calamity fails to resolve due to no longer having a legal target.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal, copying it and returning it to your hand.
Resolve the newly copied Narset's Reversal, copying the remaining copy of Invoke Calamity and returning it to your hand.
Resolve the copied Invoke Calamity, casting Invoke Calamity without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Once you have done so, you may choose to cast any number of instants or sorceries from your hand or graveyard with mana value six or less without paying their mana costs during step 3.

1663-2232-3273-5012.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Pyrogenius onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Novice Pyromancer to your hand.
+2 Chandra, Pyrogenius dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Novice Pyromancer onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Pyrogenius to your hand.
-1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1263-4647-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have attacked with at least one creature this turn.
1263-4647-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill two cards.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
